claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 233 miles of Sandy Hook (29th 10 a. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br.), Tibbits, Liverpool April 14, Queenstown
16th, with mdse. and 733 pass. to John G. Dale. April 17th, 185 miles
W. of Fastnet, passed steamship Louisiana. 24th, lat. 43 50, lon. 45 08[?],
Br. bark Gooyer[?] Castle, bound W. 27th, lat. 41 33, lon. 61, 7:30 p. m.,
a steamer bound E., showing one blue light and one rocket. 29th, 10
a. m., 233[?] miles of Sandy Hook, passed steamships America, City of
Boston, and Teutonia; 1 p. m., steamship Hibernia, bound E.
